cuts.reason: Cuts from the wide two-shot establishing the salon setup to a tighter framing right as the line pivots to the 'someone had to take that video 14 times' punchline, pushing focus onto the couple as the joke lands.
Cuts in tight to a close-up of the man's deadpan face immediately after the punchline is delivered, isolating his unimpressed reaction as the visual payoff of the joke.
Hard cut from the held reaction shot to the black title card, ending the sketch abruptly right after the silent comedic beat finishes playing out.

reaction_shots.description: Close-up push-in on the bespectacled man holding his cucumber water, giving a long deadpan, unimpressed stare that serves as the silent punctuation to the punchline.

pacing_notes: Shots shrink steadily across the sketch: the opening wide two-shot runs 4.4s to set up the scenario, the mid shot tightens to about 3.1s to deliver the punchline, then the camera holds on a 2.5s silent reaction close-up to let the joke land, before a quick 1.0s title card closes it out. The overall rhythm is a slow contraction from setup to punchline to a lingering deadpan beat, mirroring the dry, deadpan comedic tone rather than a rapid-fire cut pattern.
